title: The tanh-Gaussian policy, the reparameterised actor, and the temperature
brief: Compute a squashed Gaussian's log-probability with its change-of-variables term, check it against a numerical density, build SAC's reparameterised actor loss and soft critic target, and tune the temperature toward a target entropy.
hints: gaussian_log_prob is -0.5 * ((u - mean) / std)**2 - log_std - 0.5 * log(2 * pi), summed over the last dimension.
log(1 - tanh(u)**2) equals 2 * (log(2) - u - softplus(-2 * u)). Use torch.nn.functional.softplus, and sum over the last dimension.
In sample_action, subtract tanh_log_det(u) and D * log(max_action) from the Gaussian log-probability of u. Compute the log-probability from u, never from atanh of the action.
temperature_loss detaches (log_prob + target_entropy), so its gradient in log_alpha is alpha times (entropy - target). When the entropy is below target, a descent step raises alpha.
